# PrimeLoft Tech

> PrimeLoft Tech provides website and software development, mobile app development, UI/UX design, SEO and related digital services.

Website: https://primeloft.tech/

This file is a concise guide to the public website. The linked pages provide service details and contact information.

## About

- [Homepage](https://primeloft.tech/): Overview of PrimeLoft Tech and its digital services.
- [About PrimeLoft Tech](https://primeloft.tech/about.html): Company information and approach to working with businesses.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://primeloft.tech/services.html): Explore the available services.
- [UI/UX Design](https://primeloft.tech/service-design.html): Interface design, wireframes and prototypes for websites, mobile apps and software products.
- [Product Strategy](https://primeloft.tech/service-strategy.html): Product discovery, platform selection, technical feasibility and development roadmaps.
- [Website & Software Development](https://primeloft.tech/service-engineering.html): Custom websites, web applications and business software.
- [Mobile App Development](https://primeloft.tech/service-mobile-app-development.html): iOS, Android and cross-platform applications, including API integration and support.
- [SEO Services](https://primeloft.tech/service-seo.html): Technical SEO, on-page optimization, keyword research and website audits.
- [AI & Automation](https://primeloft.tech/service-ai.html): Business workflow automation, API integrations and AI-assisted tasks.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://primeloft.tech/service-cloud.html): Cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines and monitoring.
- [Software Testing & QA](https://primeloft.tech/service-quality.html): Functional testing, regression testing, test automation and API testing.
- [Maintenance & Support](https://primeloft.tech/service-maintenance.html): Updates, bug fixes and ongoing technical support.
- [WordPress Development](https://primeloft.tech/service-wordpress.html): WordPress development, redesigns, WooCommerce and ongoing support.
- [Squarespace Development](https://primeloft.tech/service-squarespace.html): Website design, customization, redesigns and support.

- [E-commerce Development](https://primeloft.tech/service-ecommerce.html): Storefronts, checkout, payments and order workflows.
- [API Integration](https://primeloft.tech/service-integrations.html): Connected business tools, APIs and webhooks.
